heard: A Soviet space shuttle flew into orbit with no crew. Most people thought NASA built the only orbital shuttle. Soviet leaders feared American shuttles could drop nuclear bombs, so the Soviets built their own shuttle, named Buran. Unlike America's orbiter, Buran carried no main launch engines. The super-heavy Energia rocket pushed it into orbit. Buran circled Earth twice with an empty cockpit, onboard computers guided landing through heavy crosswinds. It executed a fully automated touchdown on the runway. No pilot touch controls when a Soviet space shuttle flew into orbit.
